deals.evidence: o objetivo do fundo é captar R$ 240 milhões para pagar dívidas antigas
deals.headline: São Paulo FC sets up a receivables fund (FIDC) with Galapagos Capital and OutField to refinance bank debt
deals.investor: FIDC São Paulo Futebol Clube (structured by Galapagos Capital and OutField)
deals.summary: A credit-rights fund backed by broadcast, naming-rights and sponsorship receivables, aiming to raise R$240m (target, per ge via InfoMoney) to repay bank debt. The 2025 accounts say it began operating in November 2024, with R$81.691m of subordinated quotas paid in by the club and up to R$117.373m of senior quotas subscribed by third parties at 31 Dec 2024; it is administered by Vórtx and not consolidated.

deals.evidence: R$ 110 milhões serão antecipados pela Ticketmaster e ressarcidos pelo São Paulo, com juros, ao longo de cinco anos
deals.headline: Deliberative Council approves five-year Ticketmaster deal with a R$110m repayable advance
deals.summary: Ticketmaster takes over ticketing and the sócio-torcedor programme for five years; the deal gives R$140m up front, of which R$110m is an advance on future ticketing and membership receipts repaid with interest over five years, plus R$30m paid in cash for a stadium box and a R$6m loan for museum works. Approved 184–44.

name: São Paulo Futebol Clube
notes: Accounts are calendar-year 2025 (R$ thousands in the PDF). Revenue is 'total das receitas operacionais', net of direito de arena and including R$283.756m of player sales. The auditor (RSM) gave a qualified opinion over undocumented bank withdrawals (nota 26). Net debt is stated only as a R$110m reduction, with the level in a chart; not recorded. No exact average attendance or dated social follower counts found on a citable page. Operating result recorded is the club's own adjusted EBITDA. Leadership: Harry Massis Junior was interim president from 16 Jan 2026 and is listed as Presidente on the club site (presidency page) as of Oct 2026; whether a General Assembly has since ratified the removal was not checked. SAF talks in 2026 (study presented by businessman Diego Fernandes to Harry Massis, MKT Esportivo 28 May 2026) are exploratory and not recorded as a deal. Superbet master sponsorship runs to 2030; New Balance is cited from the 2024 kit launch. Betting sponsors: a provisional measure (MP) announced 25 Sep 2026 bans betting operators and their advertising in Brazil from 6 Oct 2026 (Máquina/MKT Esportivo, 2 Oct 2026), so a betting-house shirt sponsor may not survive the season.

ownership_summary: São Paulo Futebol Clube is a not-for-profit civil association owned by its members (associados); it has not converted its football into a SAF. President Julio Casares was removed by the Deliberative Council on 16 January 2026 and vice-president Harry Massis Junior took over; in 2026 the club has heard SAF proposals but none is agreed.
